AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Half of a credential pair. AWS calls the id non-secret, but this registry reversed that call on 20260907 for the same key in aws/credentials: an id baked into a bundle still names the account.

AWS_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The signing secret. Shown once at creation.

AWS_SES_REGION.description: Which SES region. Identities are per-region.
